articles.title: Sources: Texans trade for Lions RB Montgomery
articles.summary: The Lions are trading running back David Montgomery to the Texans for offensive lineman Juice Scruggs and two draft picks, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Sources: Commanders to release CB Lattimore
articles.summary: The Commanders have informed cornerback Marshon Lattimore that they intend to release him before the new league year begins next week, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Texans trade RT Howard to Browns, source says
articles.summary: The Texans have agreed to trade starting right tackle Tytus Howard to the Browns for a fifth-round draft pick, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Chiefs to cut Taylor, save $20M on cap
articles.summary: The Chiefs have informed offensive tackle Jawaan Taylor that he will be released before the start of the league year, barring a trade, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Cowboys' Ezeiruaku has hip surgery
articles.summary: Cowboys pass rusher Donovan Ezeiruaku underwent hip surgery to repair a labrum tear five weeks ago, but he could be out until the start of training camp, according to a source.

articles.title: Bengals keep OL Risner in fold with 1-year deal
articles.summary: The Bengals retained one of their best offensive linemen ahead of the start of free agency, signing right guard Dalton Risner to a one-year deal.

articles.title: Commanders to pay D.C. $1M to settle '22 lawsuit
articles.summary: The Commanders have agreed to pay $1 million to the District of Columbia to settle a lawsuit from 2022 that alleged the NFL team under previous ownership colluded to deceive fans.

articles.title: Sources: Vikings to trade or cut Jones, Hargrave
articles.summary: The Vikings have informed running back Aaron Jones and defensive tackle Javon Hargrave that, barring a trade, they will be released at the start of the 2026 league year, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
